name: eglobe-solutions-frontend
description: Build tooling for the eGlobe Solutions static frontend: minifies CSS/JS and optimizes images, then syncs the output into the .NET backend's wwwroot.

scripts.build:js: terser js/main.js -c -m -o js/main.min.js && terser js/calculator.js -c -m -o js/calculator.min.js
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js && npm run build:images && npm run build:sync-wwwroot
scripts.test: npm run check:headings && npm run check:wwwroot-sync
